---
title: Mussel Risotto
id: MAR-0097
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 45
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 1 kg mussels
- 300 g rice
- 30 g sour butter
- 1 l scant fish stock
- 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
- 20 g parsley
## Method
1. Scrub the mussels under running water, remove the beard, collect them in a saucepan, cover and let them open over high heat, stirring; it will take about 5 minutes.
2. Shell them and strain the liquid that has formed.
3. Bring the stock to a boil.
4. Wash the parsley, remove the stems and chop it.
5. In a saucepan, heat the oil and toast the rice for a minute.
6. Moisten it with the strained mussel liquid and as soon as it evaporates, add ladles of fish stock as the rice absorbs it.
7. As soon as the rice is cooked, add the mussels, parsley and sour butter; mix and serve.
